chunks: You are the supporters of Truth, and the brethren in faith,
the shields on the day of tribulation, and the inner circle among the people,
With you I strike the one who turns away, and I hope for the obedience of the one who advances forward,
Therefore, assist me with sincere advice free from deceit, pure from doubt;
By Allah, I am the most deserving of the people [to be followed]!
ai.seo_question: What qualities does Imam Ali attribute to his companions in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this passage from *Nahj al-Balagha*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) highlights the Ansar as his inner circle (*al-bitana*) and shield (*al-junan*) during times of crisis, emphasizing their role in consolidating his political and spiritual authority. He urges them to offer *munasaha* (sincere counsel) free from deceit, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the leader's reliance on trusted companions for just governance. This assertion of closeness (*awla*) reinforces the concept of legitimate leadership rooted in both divine appointment and communal support.

en.sayed-ali-raza: You are supporters of Truth and brethren i faith.
You are the shield on the day of tribulation, and (my) trustees among the rest of the people.
With your support I strike the runner away and hope for the obedience of him who advances forward.
Therefore, extend to me support which is free from deceit and pure from doubt
because, by Allāh, I am the most preferable of all for the people.
